description: This PHP file defines the class SyncInboundEmailAccountsInvalidSubActionArgumentsException, a custom exception used within the SuiteCRM project to handle cases where an action is called with incorrect arguments. It includes a constructor and a method to identify the caller method in the call stack.

classes.name: SyncInboundEmailAccountsInvalidSubActionArgumentsException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception to handle invalid sub-action arguments in the SuiteCRM email inbound accounts module. It constructs a detailed message including the caller method name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message indicating an invalid action call, appending the caller method name obtained via getCallerMethod().

methods.name: getCallerMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the caller method from the backtrace, using a specified stack depth. Defaults to a step of 2.
